A lovely family lunch with a great Monday offer
Oct 2026 • Family
We took our kids out for lunch and decided to visit Kampong for its Hainanese chicken rice. The rice was fragrant and nicely cooked, while the chicken was tender and juicy. It was also great to hear about the Monday offer for member customers, with Hainanese chicken rice priced at VND 99,000 from October 15, 2026. This sounds like a good deal for families who enjoy coming here regularly. The restaurant was spacious enough for us to dine comfortably with the children, although parking nearby was a little inconvenient during the weekend rush.

A little treat after exams
Oct 2026 • Family
A group of us went here after finishing our midterm exams. As students, we did find the prices a bit high, but it was worth treating ourselves once in a while. We ordered chicken rice and several dipping sauces, and the dark soy sauce with chopped ginger was probably our favorite. The chicken was tender and the rice was nicely cooked, so we ended up ordering more. The restaurant was quite busy that day, and we had to ask a few times when we wanted extra dipping sauce. Overall, it is a nice place to try with friends if you don't mind spending a little more.

Stopped by for lunch after a business meeting
Oct 2026 • Business
I had a meeting with a partner in Hai Ba Trung in late September, and decided to stop by Kampong Lo Duc for lunch afterward. The parking attendant was really helpful and even chatted with me a little, which was a nice way to relax after riding through the hot and dusty streets. I ordered a chicken thigh rice set with iced tea, and the food came out pretty quickly. The chicken was tender, the skin was nicely fatty, and the rice was fluffy with just the right amount of seasoning. It is definitely more expensive than a typical local rice shop, but the quality was good. It was quite crowded with office workers at lunchtime, so it was a little noisy.

A comfortable lunch for one
Oct 2026 • Solo
I had just arrived in Hanoi from Saigon in late September, and after walking around and enjoying the festive atmosphere, I stopped by Kampong Lo Duc for lunch. The restaurant has air conditioning and the tables are spaced out quite well, so eating alone felt completely comfortable. I ordered chicken rice, and the rice was fragrant and soft while the steamed chicken was tender and not dry at all. My favorite part was the ginger dipping sauce, which was aromatic with a slight kick. The staff were polite and helpful, even though I was dining alone.

Lunch with colleagues and a business partner
Sep 2026 • Business
I was in Hanoi on a business trip with three colleagues, and our local business partner invited us to lunch at Kampong on Dao Tan Street. We had another meeting afterwards, so we ordered one of the set meals to keep things simple. The rice was soft, the boiled chicken had nicely golden skin, and the dipping sauce went well with it. Hanoi was still quite warm at the end of August, so I also ordered the pandan tea with aloe vera and chia seeds. It was a refreshing drink. The restaurant is right on the main street, so it was easy to find, and the staff were fairly quick even though there were already quite a few customers when we arrived. A convenient option for a quick business lunch.
